phrase: a Kheer and Indian Desserts Brand
verdict: Yes. La Kheer Deli from Pune pitched kheer in many flavours on Shark Tank India Season 1, but didn't get a deal. Indian desserts like kheer are loved but rarely branded, and a modern outlet or packaged range can stand out.
angle: Kheer, phirni and other Indian desserts sell in outlets, delivery and events. New flavours attract younger buyers. Shelf life and cold chain are challenges for packaged versions.
